question: Identify the tone of the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Critical'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The tone of the passage is: **'Critical'.**
 
• In this given passage, the author means adverse or disapproving comments or judgements.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Fictional'** means A work of fiction is created in the imagination of its author, who invents the story and makes up the characters, the plot or storyline, the dialogue and sometimes even the setting.
 
• **'Descriptive'** means they are usually more common in narrative passages because they help create a vivid picture for the reader. One way to identify a descriptive passage is by its use of sensory language.
 
• **'Comical'** means it makes you want to laugh because it seems funny or silly.
